variables.buildCommand:
elixir --version && node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),cp=require("child_process");fs.writeFileSync("qa-a763.ex","defmodule QaA763 do
  def start do
    tools = Enum.map(["node", "npm", "yarn", "pnpm"], fn name ->
      {value, 0} = System.cmd(name, ["--version"], stderr_to_stdout: true)
      name <> "=" <> String.trim(value)
    end)
    body = Enum.join(["QA_A763_ELIXIR雪", "elixir=" <> System.version(), "otp=" <> System.otp_release()] ++ tools, "\n") <> "\n"
    IO.write(body)
    {:ok, listener} = :gen_tcp.listen(String.to_integer(System.get_env("PORT") || "3000"), [:binary, active: false, reuseaddr: true, ip: {0, 0, 0, 0}])
    serve(listener, body)
  end
  defp serve(listener, body) do
    {:ok, socket} = :gen_tcp.accept(listener)
    case :gen_tcp.recv(socket, 0, 5000) do
      {:ok, _} -> :gen_tcp.send(socket, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\r\nContent-Length: #{byte_size(body)}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n" <> body)
      {:error, _} -> :ok
    end
    :gen_tcp.close(socket)
    serve(listener, body)
  end
end
");for(const n of ["node","npm","yarn","pnpm"]){const r=cp.spawnSync(n,["--version"],{encoding:"utf8"});console.log("QA_A763_BUILD "+n+" "+r.stdout.trim());if(r.status!==0)process.exit(r.status||1)}' && elixirc qa-a763.ex

Check that the path returns a 2xx or 3xx status on the service's own port — an unset Health Check Path falls back to a TCP connect, which only asks whether the process is listening.
